note: THE EVAL CORPUS. Three real documents, all in the public domain, all
fetched from stable government endpoints and converted to plain text by
The converted .txt files are COMMITTED to the repository, so `npm run eval`
works offline and against exactly the bytes the checked-in question set was
written for. `npm run eval:fetch` re-fetches from source and verifies each
file against the sha256 below; run it to prove the corpus has not drifted,
or with --update after deliberately changing a source.
WHY THESE THREE: they are the three shapes this product exists for — a long
regulation dense with cross-references, a clinical guideline written as
numbered recommendations, and a contract template of short numbered
clauses. Each stresses retrieval differently, and the differences show up
in the per-document breakdown of the report.
